The car moves through a city street with parked cars and apartment buildings visible through the windshield. (2) As the vehicle continues forward, a second person's hand enters the frame from the left, presenting a small red square card or envelope. The main character takes the red card while still keeping their right hand near the dashboard controls. The lighting is natural and bright, highlighting the orange-brown leather upholstery. (3) The person continues to rhythmically adjust the car's interior settings, touching the central digital screen and toggling the air conditioning knobs. The camera remains static relative to the car's interior, showing the smooth motion of the car as it travels down the urban road with green trees and streetlights passing by.
